author: Muhammad Zulhusni
description:
First Mate Technologies has detailed a software development workflow that uses separate AI models to write and verify code. One model handles implementation, while another designs test cases and reviews the finished code before changes are cleared for merging. The company used the process on QueueMate, a restaurant queue management application built largely with AI […]

title: Should AI coding agents test their own code?
